project_summary: Headless e-commerce storefront with real-time inventory and personalized product recommendations

components.name: Headless storefront (Next.js)
components.description: SSR/ISR product catalog, cart, and checkout UI consuming Commerce API with i18n for ES/PT markets.

components.name: Real-time inventory service
components.description: Stock reservation at checkout, warehouse sync via events, and low-stock alerts to merchandising team.

components.name: Recommendation microservice
components.description: Collaborative filtering pipeline with A/B test hooks and fallback to rule-based bestsellers.

components.name: Checkout and payments integration
components.description: Stripe Payment Element, BNPL provider hook, and order confirmation emails via SendGrid.
